title: Capture golden state
summary: Capture a new golden through the governed operation to seal current cause-bearing probes. On macOS it first asks a running Safari to quit and waits for it, never force-quitting, so Safari's state is on disk; macOS harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store stay outside the archive. Saving a completed sign-in is this same capture. An undeclared nonzero probe exit retries once with both attempts retained; a declared failure stops immediately.
